title: Indie Folk
tagline: Acoustic songwriting with an independent, intimate point of view.
summary: Indie folk brings folk's acoustic instruments and narrative songwriting into independent music scenes. Its arrangements can be spare or richly layered, often favoring close vocals, unusual textures, and a handmade feel over conventional polish. The style moves easily between solo performance and ensemble work, connecting older folk traditions with contemporary songwriting.

pillars.name: Iron & Wine
pillars.why: Iron & Wine brought hushed vocals and carefully detailed acoustic arrangements to a defining indie-folk catalog.

pillars.name: Bon Iver
pillars.why: Bon Iver expanded intimate folk songwriting with layered voices and adventurous studio production.

pillars.name: Fleet Foxes
pillars.why: Fleet Foxes combined folk-rooted writing with intricate harmonies and spacious, nature-focused arrangements.
